facts.text: Tipton earned its name when settlers renamed the town after John Tipton, a veteran of the Battle of Tippecanoe and the War of 1812.
The city library opened its doors in 1900 and was completed the following year, becoming a cornerstone of local learning.
In the 1850s a rough railroad ran through Tipton, so rough that a visitor once called it “the worst railroad bed I had ever seen.”.
Tipton County’s historic courthouse and jail, built in the 19th century, were added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1984.
Tipton County was established in January 1844, and the town quickly became the county seat as the region organized its government.
The Tipton Chamber of Commerce began its work on March 24, 1914, helping to shape the town’s business community for over a century.
